identifierSource.description: The source segment this project's own identifiers carry in a cross-source citation. Defaults to the project name in lower kebab case.

citedSources.description: Other sources a citation in this project may name, beyond owasp, rfc, and standards.

reviewedStandardsVersion.description: The standards release whose complete contract this project last reviewed.

apiSolution.description: Path to the API solution. A consumer with no backend omits it and records a SCOPE.BACKEND.001 decision.

docs.description: Root of the specification tree. Every Markdown file under it carries a metadata block unless the path is listed in unstructuredDocs.

language.description: The project language record, validated against schemas/language.schema.json. Defaults to language.json under the documentation root.

languageScan.description: Glob patterns naming the non-Markdown surfaces the vocabulary is checked over: source, interface copy, the API contract, acceptance tests. Repository-relative. A scope in the language record is matched against the repository-relative path for these files. Each pattern must match at least one file.

unstructuredDocs.description: Paths whose Markdown is navigation or prose rather than specification.

testRoots.description: Directories holding automated test source. An acceptance criterion is cited from one of these, as a scenario tag, a C# AcceptanceCriterion trait, or a bracketed browser-test title.

surfaces.description: The surfaces outside paths.frontends that invoke a use case: a command-line tool, a distributed server, a background host, an event reaction. Each frontend is already a surface under its own name. A Consumers row names one of these.

uiPackage.description: The workspace's one shared UI package: the registry configuration, the copied primitive source, the token stylesheet, the source lock, and the design contract. A workspace with no controlled React web frontend omits it.

platform.description: The frontend platform. Required on every entry, so a frontend outside the controlled UI contract declares that position instead of omitting the field.

allOf.$comment: A controlled React web frontend composes the shared package, so declaring one makes the package required. A workspace whose frontends are all outside the contract declares no package.

scenarioWordLimit.description: The word bound a Scenario section stays within. Omitted, the recorded default of 120 applies, and the validator refuses a value below 40.

prose.description: Where the controlled-prose baseline lives. The baseline records the debt a page carried when the measures were first applied to it, and a page whose lastReviewed date moves leaves the baseline.

baseline.description: Defaults to prose-baseline.json under the documentation root.

prohibitedKinds.description: Specification kinds this consumer does not use. A specification declaring one is refused.

parity.description: Configuration for the specification and use-case parity check. Every field is optional and every default is empty.

applicationProject.description: The Application project directory, when discovery by convention cannot resolve exactly one.

ignoreHandlers.description: Glob patterns for handlers that carry no use-case specification.

ignoreUseCases.description: Use-case specification ids that resolve to no handler.

sourceRoots.description: Directories an Implementation mapping name resolves a declaration, project, or path in. Defaults to the directory holding the solution.

foreignNames.description: Names an Implementation mapping states that a package declares rather than this repository, which no local scan can find.

specSync.description: Configuration for the specification-sync validator. Every field is optional, and each default is derived from paths.

codeRoots.description: Directories whose C# files are read for marking tags. Defaults to apps/api/src and apps/api/tests.

markedRoots.description: Directories whose type-declaring files must carry a tag. Defaults to the Domain, Application, and WebApi projects plus every test root.

featureRoots.description: Directories holding Reqnroll feature files. Defaults to apps/api/tests/{ProjectName}.Acceptance.Tests/Features, where {ProjectName} is project.name.

evidenceRoots.description: Frontend directories whose test files are read for acceptance-criterion citations. Defaults to every path in paths.frontends.

selectedExtensions.description: Extensions active for this project. A bare string selects the extension. An object also records the criterion that was met and the date the selection is next reviewed, so a selection that costs nothing to keep still expires.

primitives.description: The directory holding the registry source the pinned CLI copied in.

publicExports.description: The entry points applications may import. A primitive the composites are built from is not one of them.

profile.description: The density profile this frontend composes the shared package at.

globalCss.description: The one stylesheet this frontend declares, which imports the shared package's tokens.
